name: ch21-palu-before
caption: Petobo, south-east Palu, before the earthquake.

name: ch21-palu-after
caption: The same area weeks later. The neighbourhood slid as a single sheet of liquefied ground.

name: ch21-palu-change
caption: Ground that lost vegetation or roofs and turned bright and bare, split by distance from the bay. Petobo (the large red area around 119.91, −0.94) and Balaroa (west edge) are the liquefaction flow slides; blue along the shore is the tsunami. The small red patches in the southern farmland are harvested fields: false alarms of a simple rule.

name: ch21-palu-exposure
caption: Area of change and what stood inside it: Open Buildings v3 footprints (confidence ≥ 0.75, centroid inside) and WorldPop 2018 people. The inland figure includes the harvested-field false alarms seen on the map. This is an exposure estimate from a rule, not a damage census.
